name: Kanda Juuzou
source:
An executive at an important business partner of Shuichi's company.

He blatantly uses his position to demand entertainment and hospitality from the company.

He is also a notorious sexual harasser, and Nanami herself was subjected to his harassment several times back when she was an office lady.

He enjoys golf and is frequently invited to weekend business entertainment events.

On these occasions, he habitually takes advantage of the supposed "golf lessons" to touch the bodies of female employees who have been brought along with him.

Shuichi finds this behavior deeply distasteful.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11485]the official site[/url]]
